comment: Shows the language texts are translated into — the target store view's configured Locale.
modal: Read-only indicator of the automatic-translation target language. It follows the **Locale** of the target store view (General > Locale options), so change the language there rather than here. Differs per store view.

comment: Format of the conversion value reported to Google AdWords conversion tracking.
modal: Sets the conversion-value format sent to Google AdWords conversion tracking. Applies only when AdWords is enabled (`google/adwords/active`). Can be set per website or store view.

comment: Yes adds the PayPal Credit (financing) button to Express Checkout.
modal: Turns the **PayPal Credit** financing option on or off for Express Checkout. When **Yes**, an integrated button lets eligible buyers pay over time while you are paid up front; it still only appears to buyers PayPal deems eligible.

comment: Days a PayPal order authorization stays valid; must match your PayPal account setting.
modal: Number of days the order remains valid, mirroring the Order Valid Period on your PayPal account — keep the two in sync. Applies only when **Payment Action** is *Order*. Can be set per website.

comment: Hides the selected PayPal funding sources (e.g. Credit, cards) from the Smart Buttons.
modal: Selects which funding options to suppress on the PayPal buttons. PayPal otherwise auto-shows each eligible option to buyers; choosing options here removes those buttons from the storefront. Can differ per store view.

comment: Whether Express Checkout lets buyers pay without a PayPal account.
modal: Chooses the Express Checkout solution type — whether buyers can complete payment as a guest, without logging into or creating a PayPal account. Can be set per website.

comment: Payflow Link user login, stored encrypted; re-enter your Vendor/Merchant login if you have no extra users.
modal: The Payflow user login used to authenticate with the gateway, stored encrypted. If your account has no additional users set up, re-enter your Vendor/Merchant login here. Can be set per website.

comment: Turns the Bank Transfer payment method on or off at checkout.
modal: Enables or disables the **Bank Transfer** payment method. When **Yes**, customers can choose it at checkout. Can be set per website.

comment: Position of Bank Transfer in the list of payment methods at checkout.
modal: Sets where **Bank Transfer** appears among payment methods at checkout; lower numbers sort higher. Can be set per website.

comment: Cash On Delivery is hidden when the order total is above this amount.
modal: Upper order-total limit for **Cash On Delivery**: the method is not offered when the cart total exceeds this value. Leave empty for no maximum. Can be set per website.

comment: Turns the Check / Money Order payment method on or off at checkout.
modal: Enables or disables the **Check / Money Order** payment method. When **Yes**, customers can select it at checkout. Can be set per website.

comment: Payee name shown to customers for Check / Money Order payments.
modal: The name customers should make their check or money order payable to, shown at checkout for the **Check / Money Order** method. Can differ per store view.

comment: Order status assigned to new orders paid with Company Credit.
modal: The initial order status given to new orders placed with the **Company Credit** (Orangecat B2B) method. Choose from the statuses mapped to the New order state. Can be set per website.

comment: Position of the Zero Subtotal Checkout method in the payment list.
modal: Sets where **Zero Subtotal Checkout** (used when the order total is 0) appears among payment methods; lower numbers sort higher. Can be set per website.

comment: Name of the custom page style used to brand PayPal-hosted pages.
modal: The Page Style name configured in your PayPal account, applied to brand the PayPal-hosted checkout pages buyers see. Can differ per store view.

comment: Position of the Purchase Order method in the payment list at checkout.
modal: Sets where **Purchase Order** appears among payment methods at checkout; lower numbers sort higher. Can be set per website.

comment: Name of the custom page style used to brand PayPal-hosted pages.
modal: The Page Style name configured in your PayPal account, applied to brand the PayPal-hosted checkout pages buyers see. Can differ per store view.

comment: Payments Advanced user login; stored encrypted.
modal: The user login used to authenticate with Payments Advanced / Payflow, stored encrypted. PayPal recommends creating a dedicated additional User for this at manager.paypal.com. Can be set per website.

comment: How long (minutes) successful cron job records are kept before cleanup.
modal: Retention period, in minutes, for successfully completed jobs of the **consumers** cron group in the schedule table; older success records are purged during history cleanup.

comment: How long (minutes) failed or errored cron job records are kept before cleanup.
modal: Retention period, in minutes, for failed or errored jobs of the **default** cron group in the schedule table; older failure records are purged during history cleanup.

comment: How often (minutes) old cron history records are purged.
modal: Interval, in minutes, between cleanups of the **index** cron group's old schedule history — how frequently expired success and failure records are removed.

comment: Yes runs this cron group in its own PHP process, separate from other groups.
modal: When **Yes**, the **index** cron group runs in a separate PHP process from the main cron, isolating its jobs so they don't block other groups. When **No**, it shares the main process.

comment: Grace window (minutes) after the scheduled time before a job is marked missed.
modal: How many minutes after its scheduled time a **translate_products** cron job may still start; if it hasn't run within this window it is marked *missed* rather than executed.

comment: How often (minutes) future cron schedule entries are generated ahead of time.
modal: Interval, in minutes, at which the **translate_select_attributes** cron group pre-generates future schedule entries in the cron_schedule table.

comment: Yes lets Varnish cache static files as well as pages.
modal: When **Yes**, Varnish also caches static files, not just full pages. Applies only when the **Caching Application** is set to Varnish. Set at the default scope.
